risk_if_not_implemented: Without Agentic Output Traceability & Repudiation, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Non-Repudiation
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a non-repudiation capability to protect against an individual falsely denying having performed a particular action.
compensating_control_1.justification: Non-Repudiation (MON-34) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Agentic Output Traceability & Repudiation (AAT-40) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Session Audit
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to provide session audit capabilities that can: 
(1) Capture and log all content related to a user session; and
(2) Remotely view all content related to an established user session in real time.
compensating_control_2.justification: Session Audit (MON-18.1) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Agentic Output Traceability & Repudiation (AAT-40) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
